description: This file is a Grunt build script (gruntfile) for copying assets and managing plugin assets in a web project.

methods.name: grunt.registerTask
methods.description: Registers a Grunt task named 'copy:plugins' which copies plugin assets based on manifest files.

methods.name: grunt.config.get
methods.description: Retrieves configuration settings from Grunt configuration.

methods.name: grunt.file.exists
methods.description: Checks if a specific file or directory exists.

methods.name: grunt.fail.warn
methods.description: Logs a warning message and fails the task.

methods.name: grunt.file.setBase
methods.description: Sets the base directory for file operations.

methods.name: grunt.file.isFile
methods.description: Checks if a path refers to a file.

methods.name: grunt.file.copy
methods.description: Copies files from source to destination.

methods.name: grunt.file.expandMapping
methods.description: Expands file patterns into source-destination mappings.

methods.name: grunt.verbose.writeln
methods.description: Logs verbose messages during task execution.

methods.name: grunt.config
methods.description: Sets or gets Grunt configuration parameters.

methods.name: grunt.loadNpmTasks
methods.description: Loads external Grunt plugins such as 'grunt-contrib-copy'.
